Name: Ridgeside for Mobile Phone (And Mobile Phone Continued)
Author: ShatteredEffect
Description:
NOTE: This mod has been updated to 1.6. There are now versions for BOTH Mobile Phone Continued by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/25104754]JoXW[/url] and Mobile Phone by Aedenthorn! ONLY DOWNLOAD ONE FILE, matching whichever of the Mobile Phone Versions you have. 

Makes the Ridgeside NPCs dialogues when answering and saying goodbye on the phone more unique (this does not change in game dialogue). Currently this feature is only completed for some of the bachelors/bachelorettes. I plan to add these for everyone in the future.  

[b]AT THIS POINT, ALL NPC's (and their subsequent heart events) SHOULD BE ADDED.

[/b]If you notice that any events are missing/broken when played through Mobile Phone, [i]let me know[/i]. I did my best to test them, but there are a lot of events. 

I would like to thank Rafseazz and the Ridgeside Village Council for the creation and building of Ridgeside Village, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/18901754]aedenthorn[/url] for making this all possible through their Mobile phone mod. 

[b]You can find all the required mods here:
[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url] by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Rafseazz?gameId=1303]Rafseazz [/url]and the Ridgeside Village Council

[b]NOTE: DOWNLOAD ONLY ONE OF THE FOLLOWING! 
[/b][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6523]Mobile Phone[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/18901754]aedenthorn[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21017]Mobile Phone Continued[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/25104754]JoXW[/url]

[b]Installation: 
[/b]1: You HAVE to delete all previous folders if reinstalling!
2: This mod requires SMAPI and content patcher, so make sure you have both installed to the specifications listed on their pages. 
3: Make sure that both Ridgeside and whichever Mobile Phone Version you have are installed to the standards listed on their individual pages (including all required mods for them)
4: Either download Ridgeside Village for Mobile Phone via your mod manager, or manually
﻿a: If you do it via manager that should be it, please enjoy the mod and let me know if you run into any issues! I will do my best to sort them out. 
﻿b: If you do it manually, then manually extract the file into your mod folder, then you should be ready to go!

[b]Things planned for the future: 
[/b][list]
[*]Adding more greetings based on relationship to the Ridgeside Village NPC and other villagers. 
[*]Possibly adding Mobile Phone support for more followers, based on if I get permission from the authors.
[/list]
Translations: 
NOT UPDATED WITH LATEST FILES: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11191]Chinese [/url]courtesy of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/80293663]aonebelly[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42295]Chinese Updated[/url]﻿ courtesy of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/141186463]yhzx[/url]
NOT UPDATED WITH LATEST FILES: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29101]Spanish [/url]courtesy of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/174767394]DarthHarlock

[/url]If you would like to do a translation feel free! I'm happy to add it to the mod myself, or link to your mod here should you post one for it. Just let me know if you do, so I can get it added. 

Thanks again, and please enjoy the mod. :)
